description: This Java class implements the <if-compare-field> element for a mini-language, providing conditional comparison logic based on field values, operators, and optional formatting. It supports nested sub-operations and handles validation, execution, and artifact gathering.

classes.name: CompareFieldCondition
classes.description: Implements a conditional comparison operation based on field values, supporting nested sub-operations and validation.

classes.name: CompareFieldConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of CompareFieldCondition from XML elements.

methods.name: autoCorrect
methods.description: Automatically corrects missing 'to-field' attribute in the XML element during transition from v1 to v2.

methods.name: CompareFieldCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the condition based on XML element attributes and child elements.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates the comparison condition based on current environment and context.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes sub-operations based on the result of the condition check.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information from nested sub-operations.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string representation of the condition for debugging.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the XML element for this condition.
